audit_scope.description: Trust model for Constantinople block validation/PoW/tx processing, EIP-3045 (uncle block baseFee RPC), EIP-2935 (block hash storage contract), London fork (EIP-1559 base fee/tx types/access lists/gas refunds), and EIP-7044 (perpetually valid voluntary exits). Covers consensus validation, RPC formatting, system calls, fee markets, and CL exit signatures.

in_scope: EIP-2935 block hash storage system call
out_of_scope: EIP-7044 voluntary exit processing (Consensus Layer concern, though EL validates exit payloads)

misclassified_entities.reason: Potential Attacker from EIP-2935 security boundary is a threat model construct, not an external entity. Represents theoretical branch poisoning attack analysis.

System Address Caller from EIP-2935 is the block processing system using reserved address 0xff..fe. This is an internal EL mechanism, not an external entity. SYSTEM_ADDRESS cannot be controlled externally.
Calling Smart Contract from EIP-2935 hash retrieval is internal to the EVM. Contracts calling the history storage contract are within the EVM execution context.
Normal Contract/EOA from EIP-2935 is internal to the EVM. Regular callers interacting with the history contract are within the EL execution environment.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node (Constantinople)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Remote node propagating blocks. Blocks must pass comprehensive validation: block number, timestamp, gas limit, gas used, extra data, parent hash, difficulty, and PoW verification via Ethash.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter (Constantinople)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External account submitting transactions. Requires intrinsic gas validation, sender recovery, nonce check, balance check. Gas refund capped at 50% of consumed gas.

trusted_external_entities.name: JSON-RPC Client (EIP-3045)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External application querying uncle block data. baseFee field inclusion depends on EIP-1559 fork activation status of the requested block.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter (London)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: User or application submitting EIP-1559 transactions. max_fee_per_gas must >= base_fee. Priority fee must <= max_fee. Legacy, EIP-2930, and EIP-1559 types supported.

trusted_external_entities.name: Validator Operator (EIP-7044)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Voluntary exit submission to beacon chain gossip
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Entity holding validator signing key. Signs exits using fixed Capella fork domain. Exits are perpetually valid across forks. Replay on forked chains possible but non-harmful as exits do not transfer funds.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full header validation pipeline: block number > 0, timestamp > parent, gas limit within bounds, gas used <= limit, extra data <= 32 bytes, parent hash matches, difficulty correct. Ethash PoW verified.
Intrinsic gas validated, sender recovered from signature, nonce matches account, balance >= gas*gasPrice + value. Refund capped at 50%. Self-destruct accounts cleaned up.
Client provides block hash and uncle index. baseFee included for post-EIP-1559 blocks, omitted for pre-EIP-1559 blocks. Fork activation boundary correctly determined.

First byte determines type: legacy (RLP list), 0x01 (EIP-2930), 0x02 (EIP-1559). EIP-1559: effective_price = min(max_priority, max_fee - base_fee) + base_fee. max_fee >= base_fee required. Refund capped at 20%.
Signature validated using fixed Capella fork domain. Perpetually valid across forks. Cross-chain replay possible but exits only trigger exit process, not fund transfers.

coverage_gaps: EXT-ATTACKER-2935, EXT-SYSTEM-CALLER-2935, EXT-CALLING-CONTRACT-2935, EXT-NORMAL-CALLER-2935 were misclassified
London base fee calculation and access list gas accounting have no external entities - purely internal EL computation
EIP-2935 block hash storage has no true external entities - system call is internal EL mechanism
